visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female medical professional with short hair and glasses, wearing a khaki blazer over a white top, stands in a brightly lit dermatology clinic. She gestures with her hands while speaking directly to the camera. Behind her is a large white medical device with a digital screen. (2) A brief graphic animation displays a character resembling Cinderella wearing a white lab coat and a crown. A clock icon appears showing 12:00. The setting is a magical castle background. (3) The scene cuts back to the woman in the blazer, who continues her explanation with active hand gestures. She holds up one finger to emphasize a point. Variety captions in Chinese appear around her. (4) A close-up shot shows a hand wearing a white surgical glove operating a white Ultherapy handpiece on a patient's cheek. The device has blue buttons and green light indicators. (5) Return to the woman in the clinic; she smiles and points to her face as animated pink hearts float around her head. (6) A final white screen appears with the clinic's logo, social media handle, phone number, and physical addresses.
